notes.title: Renoir is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Renoir is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: The game was updated!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that new updates are avialable:


Free content added: 
New animations: idle animatons for ghosts and James Renoir.

New functionality:
UI: minor design changes, [Esc] button added into the menu and can be used instead of the [Back] button
Tutorial: it's become easier to find hints
Cinematics: now, it's possible to skip them only by buttons [Esc], [Space], [LMB]

Bug fixes
Minor changes, tweaks and fixes.
